quota_rules: Weights are collection targets, not claims about available artifacts or hard admission filters.
Track successful builds, unique source projects, source functions and machine functions separately.
Replays, stripped derivatives, debug artifacts and duplicate binary hashes do not add quota units.
Language/OS/architecture cells are capability-driven; unavailable cells remain visible and do not get fabricated samples.
Prefer the largest normalized target deficit among currently buildable jobs.
One repository family should not exceed 2 percent once 50 project families are available.
Keep original/obfuscated pairs, forks and architecture/compiler variants in one split group.
Do not hold back valid corpus acquisition while rare target/toolchain cells are being provisioned.
